name: @hotelclaw/chat-ui
description: Chat rich-UI catalog (the ai_ui Stream attachment vocabulary): zod prop schemas, spec validation, deep-link resolution. Shared by apps/web (render_ui tool + client renderer) and apps/agent (the eve channel bot's render_ui). Ships TS source: apps/web transpiles via next.config transpilePackages, eve's bundler handles it natively. Keep it free of react and server-only imports — @json-render/react is used ONLY for its /schema subpath (react-free).
